subsystems.name: Microcapsule shell
subsystems.role: protects the healing agent until a crack ruptures it.

subsystems.name: Healing agent
subsystems.role: flows into the crack and polymerizes to bond the faces together.

subsystems.name: Catalyst
subsystems.role: triggers rapid polymerization when mixed with the healing agent.
parts: Grubbs' catalyst or similar metathesis catalyst

subsystems.name: Polymer matrix
subsystems.role: the bulk structural material that carries load and hosts the capsules.

subsystems.name: Vascular network (optional)
subsystems.role: channels that deliver fresh healing agent for repeated damage.

buildSteps.title: Synthesize the bio-based matrix
buildSteps.detail: Plant oils or sugars are converted into polymer precursors such as epoxy or polyester resins.

buildSteps.title: Prepare the healing agent
buildSteps.detail: A liquid monomer is chosen that stays stable until it meets the catalyst.

buildSteps.title: Encapsulate the healing agent
buildSteps.detail: Emulsion or interfacial polymerization forms tiny capsules with a polymer shell around droplets of monomer.

buildSteps.title: Disperse capsules and catalyst
buildSteps.detail: Capsules and catalyst particles are mixed into the uncured resin, keeping them separate until damage occurs.

buildSteps.title: Shape and cure
buildSteps.detail: The mixture is cast, moulded or laid up with fibres, then cured to lock the capsules in place.

buildSteps.title: Test healing
buildSteps.detail: A crack is introduced and the recovery of mechanical strength is measured over time.

buildSteps.title: Scale up production
buildSteps.detail: Continuous encapsulation and compounding methods are developed to make the material in industrial volumes.

prerequisites.why: capsules must survive mixing and curing without leaking or breaking early.
plant-derived resins exist but often lack the strength or durability of petrochemical ones.
they polymerize the healing agent quickly at room temperature without external energy.
quantifying how much strength is recovered is essential to trust the material in structures.

pathway.milestone: self-healing coatings in consumer electronics and automotive finishes
structural composites with reliable healing for wind blades and aircraft parts
pathway.unlocks: longer service life and fewer inspections.

pathway.milestone: materials that combine healing with embedded sensors
pathway.unlocks: structures that report and repair damage autonomously.
